openwrt_wiki.einleitung: The Ubiquiti UniFi AC HD (also called UniFi HD, UAP-HD, UAP-AC-HD) is a 4x4 802.11ac Wave 2 access point with a dual-core ARM processor and 512 MB of RAM.
openwrt_wiki.installation_hinweis: Instructions written for Ubiquiti firmware 3.9.42 and above; earlier firmware -> soft-brick on first OpenWrt sysupgrade (TFTP recovery). Tested up until 4.3.21. Default IP 192.168.1.20, user/pass ubnt. bootselect (mtd11) Byte 7 auf 0, sysupgrade nach kernel0 (mtdblock12).
openwrt_wiki.flash_layout: NOR mx25u25635f 32768 KiB: SBL1 128K, MIBIB 64K, SBL2 128K, SBL3 192K, DDRCONFIG 64K, SSD 64K, TZ 192K, RPM 128K, APPSBL 768K, APPSBLENV 64K, EEPROM 64K, bootselect 64K, firmware 14784K (kernel ~3 MiB, rootfs, rootfs_data ~8 MiB), kernel1 14784K, debug 1 MiB, cfg 256K
openwrt_wiki.debricking: Ubiquiti TFTP recovery; resets U-Boot env and cfg, overwrites APPSBL, SBL1-3, TZ, RPM, kernel0, bootselect
openwrt_wiki.gehaeuse: 6 plastic clips and glue around the edge; cut glue, pry open. Larger antennas 2G, smaller 5G. PCB: 4 bigger philips screws to backcover, 4 smaller hold PCIe cards and heatsink. Heatsink pads to metal shielding of backcover. Ethernet and USB-C ports slide out of the case. Two antenna connectors not fully attached on author's unit; 3 of 4 plastic thread holes broke.
openwrt_wiki.revisionen: earlier board revisions have additional QCA9889 1x1 radio for spectrum analysis and Atheros 3012-BL3D Bluetooth; old HD revisions have two extra antennas; UAP-AC-SHD: Bluetooth Qualcomm CSR8811, antennas on external metal plate

lauf.notiz: ToH-Dump + Live-hwdata, OpenWrt-Wiki (inkl. UART-Foto), Support-Commit, DTS, generic.mk, Commit-Suche, Gluon-Target + PR 3361 + Tag-Vergleich, OpenWrt-Forum 81587, DeviWiki/WikiDevi (keine Seite), FCC SWX-UAPACHD (Grant-Liste, Handbuch 2016, Label, Innenfotos, C2PC-Briefe), Ubiquiti techspecs + Datenblatt 2019. Widersprüche: Leistung 12 W (Handbuch 2016) / 17 W (Datenblatt) / 24 W (ToH); Gewicht 530 g / 700 g; USB Type-C (Handbuch) vs. "Micro USB" (Label-Zeichnung); Einsatzort innen (OpenWrt) vs. geschützt außen (Hersteller). Serielle Konsole: unbestückte 4-polige Leiste J3. Kein Werkstatt-Protokoll. Offen: QIG-App, Außenfotos, Antennentabelle, Handel (Wayback 503).
